title: Finish the board
prompt: A Board has a Name and a count of Open tasks that starts at 0. Arrive(int count) should add count to Open. Finish() should lower Open by 1, but never below 0. Both methods are empty in the starter. Fill them in.
hints: Inside a method of the class, Open is this board's own count. What should it be after Arrive(2) and then Arrive(3)?
Arrive must keep the count the board already has and add to it.
In Arrive, set Open to Open + count. In Finish, subtract 1 only when Open is greater than 0.
checkLabels: A new board must keep the name it was given.
A new board must start with 0 open tasks.
After 2 arrive and then 3 more, Open must be 5.
After 3 arrive and 1 finishes, Open must be 2.
Finishing more tasks than are open must leave Open at 0.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Replaces the count with each arrival instead of adding to it.

feedback: Follow the failing sequence of calls on one board and write down Open after each call.
